Full-Time | Adelaide, South Australia

About Bide With Care Pty Ltd
Bide With Care Pty Ltd (BWC) is a registered NDIS provider committed to delivering high-quality disability and aged care support services across South Australia. We provide person-centred care tailored to participant goals, independence, dignity, and wellbeing.
Our services include disability support, community participation, in-home care, personal care, supported accommodation, and aged care services. Due to continued business growth and increasing operational demands, we are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Manager to oversee our office administration, operational systems, compliance functions, and staff coordination.

About the Role
The Office Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the administrative functions and resources of the office, including office systems, administrative staff, operational workflows, compliance systems, and business support functions.
This role plays a critical leadership function in ensuring efficient daily operations, regulatory compliance, workforce coordination, and continuous business improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Office Operations & Service Planning
•	Oversee daily office operations and administration functions to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery.
•	Contribute to the planning and review of office services, priorities, and service standards.
•	Develop, implement, and improve administrative systems, workflows, and reporting structures.
•	Drive accountability, workflow visibility, and operational efficiencies.
Resource Allocation & Staff Coordination
•	Allocate human resources, office space, equipment, and operational resources effectively.
•	Assign work to administrative staff and monitor work performance.
•	Coordinate operational communication between support workers, coordinators, nurses, and management.
•	Support workforce planning, scheduling, and resource allocation.
Compliance & Records Management
•	Manage company records, participant documentation, and office filing systems.
•	Maintain service agreements, incident reports, risk assessments, compliance registers, and internal records.
•	Ensure documentation complies with NDIS Practice Standards and Quality & Safeguards requirements.
•	Support preparation for audits, regulatory reporting, and compliance reviews.
Financial & Accounts Administration
•	Assist with accounts payable and receivable functions.
•	Manage invoices, purchase orders, reconciliations, and payment processing.
•	Assist with payroll coordination and financial administration.
•	Support budgeting and expenditure monitoring.
Operational Liaison & Problem Resolution
•	Liaise with healthcare professionals, participants, families, and external stakeholders to coordinate business operations.
•	Facilitate prompt resolution of operational, compliance, and administrative issues.
•	Support management with business planning and operational improvement initiatives.
Human Resources Coordination
•	Coordinate onboarding, recruitment support, staff induction, and compliance documentation.
•	Maintain HR records, staff training registers, and performance documentation.
•	Assist with personnel activities including hiring, performance management, payroll coordination, and supervision.
WHS & Legislative Compliance
•	Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations.
•	Maintain workplace safety records and risk management systems.
•	Ensure operations comply with relevant legislation, government regulations, and internal policies.

Essential Skills & Experience
•	Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Associate Degree or higher in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or related field.
OR
•	Minimum three years’ relevant experience in office management or business administration.
•	Strong leadership and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated experience managing office systems and administration functions.
•	Experience managing records, compliance systems, and operational workflows.
•	Strong financial administration and reporting capability.
•	Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Desirable
•	Experience in disability services, aged care, healthcare, or community services.
•	Knowledge of NDIS compliance and regulatory frameworks.
•	Experience in rostering and workforce coordination.

Why Join BWC?
•	Work with a growing and reputable NDIS provider.
•	Join a supportive and purpose-driven team.
•	Opportunity to contribute to meaningful outcomes for participants.
•	Leadership role with career growth opportunities.
If you are a highly motivated and experienced professional looking to contribute to operational excellence in a growing care organisation, we encourage you to apply.

Identify opportunities to deliver marketing led growth via our diversified service. Experience Required:  12-15 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership, excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.

Business Address: 1/31, Brantome Street, Gisborne, Vic 3437
Position Title: Cook
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum, plus superannuation

POSITION DESCRIPTION – COOK

ABOUT THE BUSINESS
Grand Guru offers an authentic North Indian dining experience, serving a wide variety of traditional Indian dishes prepared using fresh ingredients, aromatic spices, and time-honoured recipes. The restaurant features an extensive menu including tandoori entries, chicken, lamb, beef, seafood and vegetarian curries, biryanis, freshly baked naan breads, rice dishes, desserts, and refreshing beverages, catering to a diverse range of customer preferences.

POSITION SUMMARY
Grand Guru is seeking a skilled and motivated Cook to join our busy kitchen team on a full-time basis (38 hours per week).

The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing and cooking quality meals, assisting with kitchen operations, maintaining food safety standards, and supporting the Head Chef in daily kitchen activities. The role requires experience in preparing Indian cuisine and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Prepare and cook a wide variety of authentic North Indian dishes in accordance with established recipes, quality standards and presentation requirements. 
•	Prepare and cook tandoori dishes, curries, biryanis, naan breads, rice dishes, vegetarian specialties, seafood, lamb, beef and chicken dishes. 
•	Prepare ingredients by washing, peeling, chopping, marinating, grinding spices, portioning and seasoning food using traditional Indian herbs, spices and cooking techniques. 
•	Set up and organise kitchen workstations with the required ingredients, equipment and utensils prior to service. 
•	Operate and regulate the temperatures of tandoor ovens, grills, cooktops, fryers and other kitchen equipment to ensure food is cooked correctly and consistently. 
•	Examine raw ingredients and foodstuffs to ensure quality, freshness and compliance with food safety standards. 
•	Portion, plate and garnish meals in accordance with the restaurant's presentation standards and ensure timely service. 
•	Monitor food quality throughout preparation and cooking to maintain consistency and customer satisfaction. 
•	Store food appropriately, rotate stock in accordance with food safety requirements, and monitor stock levels of ingredients and kitchen supplies, reporting shortages to management. 
•	Assist the Head Chef with daily food preparation, menu items, specials and estimating ingredient requirements to minimise waste. 
•	Prepare meals to accommodate customers' dietary requirements and reasonable special requests. 
•	Maintain a clean and hygienic kitchen by cleaning work areas, equipment and utensils, and complying with all food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Assist in training and supporting junior kitchen staff and apprentices and work collaboratively with the Head Chef and kitchen team to ensure efficient kitchen operations.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
•	Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery or related field;
•	Minimum 1 year of experience in a similar Cook position within a busy restaurant or cafe environment;
•	Experience and knowledge in preparing and cooking North Indian dishes;
•	Ability to operate commercial kitchen equipment safely and effectively;
•	Strong understanding of food hygiene and kitchen safety standards;
•	Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment;
•	Good communication and teamwork skills;
•	Strong organisational and time management abilities.


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting sustainable energy systems.

This role is ideal for a creative and analytical marketing professional who enjoys developing marketing strategies, conducting market research, managing promotional activities, and supporting business growth within a growing renewable energy industry.

Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.
